title: Differentiation of a scaled radial cutoff integral with a bounded weight (Simon Ch. 4, 3.4)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (q : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (S ε B t : ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable q μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |q x| ≤ B) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ 1 → φ s = 1) → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ s → φ s = 0) → 0 < t → (1 + ε) * t < S → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x) μ ∧ Integrable (fun x => ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x) μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x ∂μ) (-(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x ∂μ) / t) t
